descriptionFromApi:
We are seeking a Staff-level AI Champion to serve as our primary technical authority in Controllable Generative AI and Computer Vision. This role will drive adoption and excellence in AI-assisted visual development across our engineering organization, empowering our teams to leverage state-of-the-art Generative AI to solve complex, real-world design challenges.
As a "Special Ops" engineer, you will lead the development of high-precision visual transformation systems bridging the gap between creative intent and pixel-perfect execution. You will prototype sophisticated solutions for context-aware scene manipulation and material synthesis, building the scalable infrastructure required to bring these innovations to life. While you will mentor and upskill technical teams in AI-first development practices, your primary focus is delivery, deep-tech problem solving, and maintaining the highest standards of engineering excellence.
Key Position Responsibilities Include:
Hands-on Generative AI & Vision (The "Core")
  • Advanced Visual Manipulation: Own the development of pipelines using Diffusion Models (Stable Diffusion, Flux, SDXL) and ControlNet/IP-Adapter to perform precise, localized edits in complex scenes (eg, swapping a floor or a cabinet style while keeping the rest of the image untouched).
  • State-of-the-Art Segmentation: Implement and fine-tune modern perception models like Mask2Former, SAM 2, or RF-DETR to achieve surgical accuracy in identifying and isolating objects within high-resolution images.
  • VLM Integration: Experiment with and fine-tune Vision Language Models (VLMs) to translate complex, nuanced user requirements into visual execution.
Model Training & Data Innovation
  • Specialized Fine-Tuning: Directly handle the training of LoRAs and adapters to teach models new visual "vocabularies" (textures, materials, or specific product styles).
  • Synthetic Data Architect: Design and build automated systems to generate high-quality synthetic training data using LLMs/VLMs to solve "data cold-start" problems for new features.
  • Accuracy Optimization: Lead the effort in improving model metrics through hyperparameter tuning, loss function customization, and active learning loops.
Engineering & Scalability (Individual Impact)
  • High-Performance APIs: Build and optimize FastAPIs that handle complex, asynchronous GenAI workloads with high reliability and low latency.
  • Inference Optimization: Work on "making it fast" by utilizing TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, or Model Quantization (INT8/FP8) to ensure high performance.
  • Technical Mentorship: Act as the "internal consultant" for other engineering teams, providing code reviews, technical workshops, and guidance on AI best practices without formal management duties.
Required Experience and Qualifications:
  • 8+ years in Data science/AI, with 3+ years of deep, hands-on experience in Generative AI or Computer Vision.
  • The "Builder" Mindset: You must be comfortable being the primary coder for complex prototypes.
  • Deep Tech Stack: Models: Expertise in Diffusion (Stable Diffusion/Flux) and Perception (Mask2Former/DETR/SAM).
  • Frameworks: Expert tensorflow/PyTorch user, Hugging Face diffusers & transformers, open CV.
  • Backend: Advanced Python, FastAPI.
  • Ops: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and GPU-based inference scaling.
  • RAG & Embeddings: Hands-on experience with Vector Databases (MongoDB, Pinecone, cosmos) for multimodal search and retrieval.
  • Good understanding of AI/ML modelling techniques and implementation experience.
Core Competencies:
  • Controllable Generation: High-fidelity, localized image edits (floors/cabinets/worktops) with zero-drift in lighting, perspective, or structural geometry.
  • Accuracy-Driven Adoption: Precision fine-tuning of Diffusion/Perception models (LoRAs, ControlNets, Mask2Former) to eliminate artifacts and maximize user trust.
  • High-Throughput Infrastructure: Build optimized inference systems (TensorRT/Triton) that generate images in quick time, even during peak user traffic.
  • Production-Ready APIs: Resilient, asynchronous FastAPI services that seamlessly bridge complex AI models with real-world design applications.
  • Self-Improving Data Flywheel: Automated synthetic data pipelines using LLMs/VLMs to continuously identify and fix model edge cases and data defects.

Job Overview
The Channel Order Management Analytics Leader is responsible for managing the overall health of the Channel organization's global open order book and leading the team supporting order management activities. This role plays a critical role within the Channel Supply Chain organization, ensuring seamless coordination between distribution partners and TE's internal Business Units (PBUs) and manufacturing plants.
Channel operates in a unique supply chain environment where distribution partners, including Arrow, TTI, Mouser, Avnet, Heilind, and others, serve as customers, while TE's PBUs and plants act as internal suppliers. This position is accountable for driving the end-to-end supply chain flow between these stakeholders, ensuring operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
The successful candidate will oversee and optimize a complex order management operation, improve supply chain visibility, and drive process excellence. In addition, the role will lead the transformation of current operational processes toward a more proactive, analytics-driven, and automated operating model. This includes leveraging data, technology, and automation solutions to improve efficiency, scalability, accuracy, and decision-making.
The role requires a proven supply chain professional with the ability to operate effectively across all levels of the organization, from detailed operational execution and planner-level problem solving to strategic decision-making and executive stakeholder engagement.
Roles Responsibilities Pillar 1 - Own Run the Operation - Order Supplier Management
Distributor-Facing Order Health
  • Own the health of the Channel open order book, including order intake, confirmations, past-due aging, exception aging, and OTIF delivery across 10-14 analysts.
  • Manage distributor backlog and exceptions, including past-due orders, unconfirmed lines, blocked orders, and expedites.
  • Support distributor-specific supply chain activities, including drop-ship and stock orders, DTAM/design-registration demand, inventory pulls, and allocation commitments.
  • Champion the TE Customer Value Proposition (CVP) to improve customer and distributor experience.
  • Ensure SAP execution discipline, including schedule lines, ATP, recommit dates, ABCON/Ship Note validation, and Late Reason Codes.
Internal Supplier Management Collaboration

  • Establish recurring reviews with PBU planners, schedulers, and supply planning teams.
  • Build collaborative relationships with BUs and plants to proactively identify and resolve constraints.
  • Translate supply constraints into distributor impact and drive mitigation plans.
  • Act as the escalation bridge between Channel, BUs, Customer Care, and distributors.

  • Re-engineer daily operations to provide analysts with prioritized work queues and reduce manual preparation effort.
  • Deploy Power BI dashboards that predict risks and support decision-making.
  • Create planner-focused views for response aging, recommit tracking, ATP failures, and pending actions.
  • Lead change management while maintaining operational performance and service levels.

Automation AI Adoption
  • Drive the automation roadmap using Power BI, Fabric, and Power Query while maintaining SAP as the system of record.

Role:- AI Software Developer

  • Experience with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a keen attention to detail, ensuring high-quality deliverables and efficient resolution of complex technical challenges.

descriptionFromApi:
Role & responsibilities

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled IDAM Architect AI to lead the architecture and governance of AI-powered developer tooling within Identity & Access Management (IAM) ecosystems. This role will own the design, engineering standards, and reusable integration patterns for AI copilots and tools used by IAM teams.

You will ensure that AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Mistral-based solutions) are implemented securely, consistently, and efficiently, while continuously evolving frameworks in response to emerging risks, platform updates, and engineering needs.

Key Responsibilities


Architecture & Strategy

  • Define and own the architecture for AI-enabled IAM development ecosystems
  • Establish engineering standards, governance models, and best practices
  • Design scalable and reusable integration patterns for AI tooling across IAM platforms
  • Align AI initiatives with enterprise architecture and security strategy

AI Tooling & Copilot Enablement

  • Lead adoption and governance of AI tools such as:
    • GitHub Copilot
    • Google Gemini
    • Claude
    • Mistral-based coding assistants
  • Design secure AI-assisted development workflows
  • Build frameworks and guardrails for LLM usage within IAM teams
  • Evaluate and onboard emerging AI developer tools

Security & Risk Management

  • Ensure secure usage of AI tools, including protection of:
    • Sensitive identity data (PII, credentials, tokens)
    • Source code and proprietary logic
  • Define controls for prompt security, data leakage prevention, and model risks
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for AI integrations
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies and standards

Integration & Engineering Excellence

  • Develop reusable integration patterns for:
    • IAM platforms (Okta, Azure AD, Ping, ForgeRock)
    • APIs and microservices
    • Cloud-native architectures
  • Standardize API security, authentication, and authorization mechanisms
  • Drive DevSecOps practices in AI-assisted IAM development

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Continuously enhance AI architecture patterns and standards
  • Monitor and optimize performance, cost, and security of AI tooling
  • Stay updated with AI and IAM industry trends
  • Lead proof-of-concepts (POCs) for new tools and capabilities

Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Act as a technical thought leader for AI in IAM
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and compliance teams
  • Mentor teams on secure and effective AI adoption
  • Drive enterprise-wide standardization and adoption

Governance & Monitoring

  • Define KPIs and metrics for AI tool usage and impact
  • Implement audit, logging, and monitoring frameworks
  • Provide insights on risk, compliance, and productivity improvements

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM/IDAM)
  • Deep knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2.0
  • Hands-on experience with AI developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude)
  • Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted workflows
  • Strong background in security architecture and DevSecOps
  • Experience with API security, microservices, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
  • Proven experience in enterprise architecture and solution design

jobDescription:
Proficiency in Java and Web API development,with a solid understanding of building and maintaining scalable,secure,and efficient backend services

Strong,hands-on experience with React,with a focus on building dynamic,interactive,and high-performance web applications

Comprehensive experience in a DevOps activities like continuous integration,continuous delivery
descriptionFromApi:
Role & responsibilities:

Job Requirements (Skills)

  • Experience with application of AI to software development patterns and processes to transform the way teams build products at scale
  • A minimum of 7 years of professional experience in production applications development in Java ecosystems including front-end development (preferrably React) and DevOps activities with a strong ability to troubleshoot, resolve, and prevent issues in a high-pressure environment.
  • Proficiency in Java and Web API development, with a solid understanding of building and maintaining scalable, secure, and efficient backend services.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with React, with a focus on building dynamic, interactive, and high-performance web applications.
  • Expertise in database design and SQL skills, particularly with SQL Server, including advanced T-SQL scripting, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Comprehensive experience in a DevOps activities like continuous integration, continuous delivery
  • Experience with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and a keen attention to detail, ensuring high-quality deliverables and efficient resolution of complex technical challenges.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LlamaIndex, Pydantic-AI, LangChain, or similar.
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing RAG pipelines, knowledge graphs, and context-aware agent architectures.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with relevant libraries (e.g., FastAPI, Pydantic, OpenAI API).
  • Experience with observability and evaluation tools for AI agents, such as Phoenix and Ragas, including setting up monitoring dashboards and performance metrics.
  • Solid understanding of prompt engineering, memory management, and agent orchestration patterns.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and deploying agentic solutions in production environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex agentic concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  • Commitment to responsible AI practices, including transparency, fairness, and compliance with regulatory standards

descriptionFromApi:
Role & responsibilities

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled IDAM Architect AI to lead the architecture and governance of AI-powered developer tooling within Identity & Access Management (IAM) ecosystems. This role will own the design, engineering standards, and reusable integration patterns for AI copilots and tools used by IAM teams.

You will ensure that AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Mistral-based solutions) are implemented securely, consistently, and efficiently, while continuously evolving frameworks in response to emerging risks, platform updates, and engineering needs.

Key Responsibilities


Architecture & Strategy

  • Define and own the architecture for AI-enabled IAM development ecosystems
  • Establish engineering standards, governance models, and best practices
  • Design scalable and reusable integration patterns for AI tooling across IAM platforms
  • Align AI initiatives with enterprise architecture and security strategy

AI Tooling & Copilot Enablement

  • Lead adoption and governance of AI tools such as:
    • GitHub Copilot
    • Google Gemini
    • Claude
    • Mistral-based coding assistants
  • Design secure AI-assisted development workflows
  • Build frameworks and guardrails for LLM usage within IAM teams
  • Evaluate and onboard emerging AI developer tools

Security & Risk Management

  • Ensure secure usage of AI tools, including protection of:
    • Sensitive identity data (PII, credentials, tokens)
    • Source code and proprietary logic
  • Define controls for prompt security, data leakage prevention, and model risks
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for AI integrations
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies and standards

Integration & Engineering Excellence

  • Develop reusable integration patterns for:
    • IAM platforms (Okta, Azure AD, Ping, ForgeRock)
    • APIs and microservices
    • Cloud-native architectures
  • Standardize API security, authentication, and authorization mechanisms
  • Drive DevSecOps practices in AI-assisted IAM development

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Continuously enhance AI architecture patterns and standards
  • Monitor and optimize performance, cost, and security of AI tooling
  • Stay updated with AI and IAM industry trends
  • Lead proof-of-concepts (POCs) for new tools and capabilities

Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Act as a technical thought leader for AI in IAM
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and compliance teams
  • Mentor teams on secure and effective AI adoption
  • Drive enterprise-wide standardization and adoption

Governance & Monitoring

  • Define KPIs and metrics for AI tool usage and impact
  • Implement audit, logging, and monitoring frameworks
  • Provide insights on risk, compliance, and productivity improvements

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM/IDAM)
  • Deep knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2.0
  • Hands-on experience with AI developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude)
  • Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted workflows
  • Strong background in security architecture and DevSecOps
  • Experience with API security, microservices, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
  • Proven experience in enterprise architecture and solution design

Design and support disaster recovery solutions for Azure and hybrid workloads.

Ensure defined RPO/RTO requirements are met.

PowerShell

Azure CLI

ARM/Bicep

Terraform

title: Technical Account Manager
jobDescription:
MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine:

  • Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains
  • Polished technical communications
  • Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer
  • Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience
  • A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers

The TAMs primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio. They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB. The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time.

The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs.

This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB.

Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Cool things you'll do

MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB

As a Technical Account Manager, you'll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions - resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between

You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB

You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem

What you need

You should have 7+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi-faceted

It's crucial for every candidate to check these boxes:

  • Communicator:
    • Foster open lines of communication amongst internal stakeholders; The TAM ensures all concerned parties, including in some cases the MongoDB executive team, are well informed about accounts within the TAMs portfolio (especially during critical or escalated situations)
    • Great communication and account leadership skills of external stakeholders, with a good organizational understanding of customers and ability to calibrate communication style based on the audience
    • The TAM must quickly understand and communicate about customer workloads, use cases, and resiliency criteria, including performance, availability, and scalability
  • Collaborator:
    • Ability to work independently as well as cross-functionally to ensure customer needs are being met
    • Genuine desire to help people, and to increase their confidence and good will
    • Ability to cultivate strong team partnerships: Understanding of when and how to seek help from team members, skill in choosing from potentially conflicting perspectives or approaches; ability to secure commitments and lead collaborative efforts
  • Problem Solver:
    • Comfort thinking on your feet, solving problems in real-time, and reducing pressure and anxiety through calm, authoritative technical leadership; ability to keep your cool and project command presence during escalated situations where tensions and anxiety may be high
    • Ability to design, communicate, and follow a structured approach to solving complex problems based loosely upon the scientific method
    • Experience analyzing and pursuing issues holistically in the enterprise; spanning multiple technologies, customer teams and silos
  • Technical Expert:
    • Experience building, maintaining, tuning, and troubleshooting sophisticated mission-critical production database systems
    • Familiarity with modern service architectures and the implications on development teams, their structures and the development lifecycle
    • Experience with the technologies and development patterns typical of a large-scale enterprise customer
    • Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Builder:
    • Develop, document, and help implement techniques, tools and procedures for optimizing MongoDBs technical relationship with marquee customers
  • Product evangelism:
    • The TAM helps customers understand how the MongoDB developer data platform is well-suited to solve a wide variety of their problems


Bonus Points
  • Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
  • Extensive experience with mass scale application architectures
  • Microservices/Serverless architectures
  • CI/CD tools and approaches
  • Containerization, orchestration and management tools
  • Enterprise Identity platforms
  • Experience using or managing MongoDB
  • Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
  • Strong systems engineering and troubleshooting experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, virtualization, clustering


Success Measures
  • In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training
  • In 6 months, you will be confident working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
  • In 12 months, you will be directly and independently engaged in technical account management, ensuring customers are successful and happy with MongoDB and see our developer data platform as the de facto standard for new projects

BlackLine SaaS is the system of interaction for finance and accounting teams and it integrates with numerous ERPs, CRMs, Payment systems, Point of Sale systems and other applications. You will be driving innovation into our product suite by designing, developing, troubleshooting, maintaining, optimizing and scaling cloud-based applications and services. In addition to being a hands-on engineer, you will also lead and mentor other engineers in the team. If you have a passion for delivering products that make a difference, are driven to make things better in all that you do and are eager to work in a collaborative agile environment where developers are dedicated to solving customer problems and innovating, we would love to talk to you.

Youll Get To:

  • Provide technical expertise in requirements analysis, design, effort estimation, development, testing, and delivery of highly scalable and secure distributed backend and AI-powered services
  • Design, develop, and deploy intelligent agents and AI-driven features to enhance our product capabilities.
  • Utilize Python and its ecosystem of libraries to build, train, and deploy machine learning models and agentic systems.

  • Mentor and coach team members to guide them to solutions on complex design issues and do peer code reviews.
  • Proactively identify issues, bottlenecks, gaps, or other areas of concern or opportunities and work to either directly affect change or advocate for that change.

  • 6+ years of professional experience in building Web scale, highly available, multi-tenant SaaS with a focus on backend platforms, frameworks, RESTful APIs, and microservices.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Python programming, particularly for AI/ML and backend development.
  • 3+ years of active experience in AI/ML projects, with a strong focus on developing and implementing agentic AI systems, AI Agents, large language models (LLMs), and natural language processing (NLP).

  • Experience with public cloud architectures (Azure, ASW or GCP) and cloud native services.

jobDescription:
Lead Applied AI Research Engineer
Location: Hyderabad, India
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Model: On-site
Business Unit: Winfo Research Labs
Reporting To: Head of Winfo Research Labs
Role Type: Hands-on technical leadership and individual contributor role

Role Description
The Lead Applied AI Research Engineer will be WRL s hands-on technical research leader responsible for converting complex and often ambiguous business problems into structured AI research and experimentation programs.
The role begins with understanding the business problem, breaking it into smaller decision and capability components, and determining which parts can be solved using established methods, which require experimentation, and which present genuine research opportunities. The Lead Applied AI Research Engineer will then formulate hypotheses, compare alternative approaches, build and evaluate proof-of-concepts, and determine whether a proposed solution has sufficient technical and business evidence to move into development.
This is not a purely academic research role, a conventional data science role, or a production engineering role. It is an applied research and technical leadership position for someone who can move comfortably between business problem discovery, AI research, experimentation, prototyping, evaluation, and solution architecture.
The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, domain specialists, AI engineers, data engineers, cloud architects, product teams, and deployment specialists. Once an approach has been validated, the researcher will produce a clear engineering handoff covering the solution architecture, experimental evidence, evaluation results, data requirements, risks, constraints, and recommended implementation path.
Required Qualifications
  • Demonstrated experience translating business or customer problems into applied AI solutions.
  • Strong ability to break complex problems into researchable and executable components.
  • Hands-on experience designing experiments and creating proof-of-concepts.
  • Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and agentic AI.
  • Proficiency in Python and practical experience with modern ML and AI development frameworks.
  • Experience defining evaluation criteria and comparing alternative models, architectures, or workflows.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience collaborating with software engineering, data, cloud, architecture, or product teams.
  • Demonstrable portfolio of AI solutions, PoCs, prototypes, research projects, or shipped capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in an ambiguous, rapidly evolving research and innovation environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Master s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with enterprise AI use cases and enterprise application environments.
  • Understanding of cloud AI platforms, model serving, data pipelines, APIs, security, and observability.
  • Experience developing reusable AI components, accelerators, or reference architectures.
  • Experience with optimization, multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, fine-tuning, synthetic data, or advanced evaluation methods.
  • Experience contributing to patents, publications, open-source projects, technical articles, or research communities.
  • Previous experience in an applied research group, innovation lab, product organization, startup, or customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience mentoring researchers, data scientists, or AI engineers.
A postgraduate research qualification is valuable but should not replace evidence that the candidate has previously converted a customer or business problem into a credible, evaluated solution. The WRL hiring material similarly lists a PhD as a bonus while emphasizing demonstrated AI solutions, research depth, technical literacy, and buildable specifications.
What Success Looks Like
A successful Lead Applied AI Research Engineer will:
  • Turn ambiguous business opportunities into well-defined research and experimentation plans.
  • Build PoCs that answer explicit feasibility and value questions.
  • Use objective evaluation evidence to recommend whether an idea should proceed.
  • Provide Development with clear, reproducible, and implementation-ready handoffs.
  • Establish a repeatable applied research and PoC methodology for WRL.
  • Create reusable knowledge, benchmarks, reference patterns, and technical assets.
  • Help WRL avoid both premature production investment and endless experimentation.
  • Build technical credibility with customers, internal stakeholders, researchers, and engineers.
  • Develop junior team members while remaining directly involved in high-value technical work.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Phone Billing
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Were looking for a Staff Engineer to lead the technical direction and evolution of Phone Billing, one of the most critical components of HighLevels communication platform. Phone Billing sits at the intersection of product usage, infrastructure, and revenue - it is responsible for accurately metering and monetising usage across LC Phone products, including voice, messages, phone numbers, and other communication services.

The scale and criticality of this system make billing correctness non-negotiable. Every communication event can have a financial implication, and a single billing error can impact revenue, customer trust, and financial reconciliation at the same time. The platform processes 100M+ events daily across 15+ services, with billing workflows that need to remain accurate and reliable despite retries, duplicate events, delayed events, provider inconsistencies, partial failures, and continuously evolving pricing models.

As a Staff Engineer, youll own the architecture, scalability, reliability, and technical strategy of the Phone Billing platform. Youll solve complex distributed-systems problems around usage metering, rating, charging, idempotency, reconciliation, credits, refunds, adjustments, provider cost tracking, and billing lifecycle management. Youll also drive the architectural evolution required to support significantly higher volumes without compromising financial accuracy or system performance.

A key part of the role will be building billing systems that are correct by design - ensuring that every billable event is accounted for exactly once from a business perspective, even when the underlying infrastructure operates with retries, at-least-once delivery, asynchronous processing, and failures. Youll establish robust reconciliation mechanisms between HighLevels internal usage data, provider-level usage, and customer invoices, with strong observability and auditability to quickly identify and resolve discrepancies.

Youll work closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Finance, and other Staff Engineers to define pricing and billing architecture, while partnering across Phone, WhatsApp, CPaaS, and provider-integration teams. Youll influence technical decisions beyond a single team, establish engineering standards, identify systemic technical debt, and drive long-term improvements in reliability, cost efficiency, data architecture, and operational excellence.

The broader Phone Core ecosystem includes CPaaS platform services, Trust Compliance, and phone number provisioning, giving this role significant architectural influence across the communication platform. Your primary focus, however, will be making Phone Billing a highly scalable, financially accurate, resilient, observable, and extensible platform capable of supporting the next 10x growth of HighLevels communication business.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical health of Phone Billing - proactively identify architectural bottlenecks, correctness and reliability risks, and technical debt; define and drive the roadmap to improve billing accuracy, reconciliation, scalability, observability, and cost efficiency as the platform scales to 10x its current volume.
  • Drive 1-2 high-impact initiatives end-to-end - take ownership from problem definition and technical discovery through architecture, implementation, rollout, and measurement, ensuring the initiatives deliver measurable improvements to Phone Billing in areas such as accuracy, reliability, scalability, or cost efficiency.
  • Architect for massive scale: Own the high-level architecture and scaling decisions for core Phone platform components, including CPaaS abstractions, provider adapters, and shared messaging/voice APIs that support billions of monthly events.
  • Own Phone Billing end to end: usage metering, rating, reserve/commit lifecycle, idempotency, reconciliation, and audit trails for the Phone channels - with zero tolerance for double-charging or lost usage
  • Lead the evolution of Revenue Growth into a configuration-driven, rules-based platform that adapts to new regulatory and carrier requirements without invasive engineering change
  • Work hands-on with technologies like NestJS, Firestore, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Queuing Systems, Data Warehousing Systems and Service Mesh-based microservices
  • Drive high-concurrency innovation: Lead the design and execution of cross-cutting initiatives to improve reliability, latency, and throughput across time-sensitive APIs and workflows serving millions of businesses.
  • Drive observability and resilience by evolving our monitoring, alerting (Prometheus/Grafana), and incident response strategies - including the financial invariants that must be alerted on, not just the technical ones
  • Leverage LLMs and AI tools to write, refactor, test, and debug code efficiently - while implementing guardrails to reduce hallucination and boost reliability
  • Partner with product, infra, security, finance and legal teams to ensure data integrity, access control, and compliance across phone services
  • Develop EM I leaders and senior engineers, build leadership pipeline, succession planning and raise the hiring bar

title: Group Product Manager - Commerce
jobDescription:
Job Summary

HighLevel's Commerce platform is the system of record for how our customers sell - what they offer and how it is priced, how orders get fulfilled, and how money moves: payments in, invoices out, and books that balance. It spans product information, pricing, taxes, and channels; fulfillment and inventory; and the full finance stack of payments, checkout, invoicing, and ledger - together powering commerce for a global base of agencies and businesses operating at scale.

We are seeking a Group Product Manager, Commerce, to lead product across three connected verticals - Business Operations, Fulfillment Operations, and Finance - and the team of Product Managers who own them. You will set the strategy for the end-to-end commerce lifecycle, from catalog to cash, and be accountable for the coherence, reliability, and growth of the platform as a whole.

Your mission: To build a coherent, reliable, and extensible commerce platform - spanning what customers sell, how it is fulfilled, and how they get paid - and to build the team that delivers it, so HighLevel's customers can run their entire business on us.

What You'll Do

  • Set Commerce Product Strategy - Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap across Business Operations, Fulfillment, and Finance, translating a broad, interdependent surface area into clear, sequenced priorities.
  • Lead Grow a Team of PMs - Manage, mentor, and hire Product Managers across the verticals, setting a high bar for product craft and owning their performance, development, and career growth.
  • Own the End-to-End Commerce Lifecycle - Be accountable for the full catalog-to-cash journey - product information and pricing, fulfillment and inventory, payments, invoicing, and ledger - as one connected system.
  • Drive Platform Coherence - Ensure shared contracts like the analytics engine, layouts, and reporting are designed once and reused, so the verticals compose into a single, consistent platform rather than a set of silos.

You will work alongside our Architect on the shape of the platform, with Cloud Platform on the infrastructure that runs it, and with every product team on how they operate what they own - without direct reports. The mandate has three parts. First, make reliability measurable: define SLIs and SLOs for our critical paths, get teams to own them, and make error budgets the shared language for prioritizing reliability against features. Second, raise the operational bar: strengthen incident response, postmortem quality, alerting, and change safety so that we find out first and repeat incidents stop repeating. Third, build the mindset: coach teams to design for failure, test for it deliberately, and treat operability as part of done - so the practices outlive your involvement in any single team.
You report directly to the VP of Engineering. That placement is deliberate: reliability standards need to apply evenly across eight engineering groups, and you need the neutrality to hold every team, including infrastructure, to the same bar.
What youll do
Make reliability measurable
  • Define SLIs and SLOs for Fingerprints critical request paths (identification, events, server APIs, client agents) with the teams that own them; make them visible, reviewed, and tied to decisions.

Raise the operational bar
  • Strengthen the incident lifecycle end to end: detection, response, communication, postmortem quality, and follow-up completion. Make the postmortem the most useful document a team writes.

  • 10+ years of engineering experience, with 3+ years as an SRE, production engineer, or reliability-focused Staff engineer operating across multiple teams - you have owned reliability for a platform, not just for a service you built.

  • Strong incident leadership: you have run incident response and postmortems for high-severity, customer-facing incidents and materially improved how an organization learns from them.
  • Hands-on depth in distributed systems failure modes - cache/database saturation and cascading failure, retry storms, capacity limits, degradation and load shedding - in a high-throughput, low-latency environment. Fluent in Kubernetes, AWS, and modern observability tooling (Datadog or equivalent).
  • Comfortable reading and writing production code (Go, TypeScript, or similar) and infrastructure as code. You can ship a fix, not just recommend one.

  • Operate for an AI-assisted org. You think about how runbooks, alerts, dashboards, and operational data should be structured so that both humans and AI agents can diagnose and act on them safely - legible signals, clear ownership, strong guardrails on automated change.
  • Pragmatism over purity. You know that reliability competes with delivery, and you can make the case for the right investment at the right time - and say when a risk is acceptable.

  • Work closely with product managers, AI/ML engineers, data scientists, architects, and business teams to move AI solutions from prototype to production .

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience , with strong full-stack application development expertise.

  • Strong programming expertise in Python .

  • Hands-on backend development experience with FastAPI, Flask, Node.js , or similar frameworks.
  • Practical experience integrating LLMs through APIs and model-serving platforms.

  • Experience deploying production applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP .
  • Hands-on knowledge of Docker, CI/CD, Git and cloud-native development .
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, API security, data privacy, and secure application development.
  • Demonstrated experience taking applications from design/prototype through production deployment and support .

Preferred Experience
  • Experience with OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Llama , or other leading foundation models.
  • Experience building multi-agent systems, AI copilots, enterprise search, conversational AI, or autonomous workflow applications .
  • Experience with model evaluation, LLM-as-a-judge techniques, human evaluation, and feedback loops.
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning/SFT, preference data, synthetic data, and model evaluation .

  • Familiarity with AI observability and evaluation platforms.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code technologies such as Terraform.
  • Understanding of Responsible AI, AI security, governance, and production LLMOps practices.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and technically deep IAM Lead to own and advance the identity security foundations of one of Indias largest digital payments ecosystems. This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for designing, implementing, and operating the full spectrum of identity and access management capabilities from enterprise SSO and lifecycle governance through to privileged access vaulting, cloud security posture, endpoint protection, data loss prevention, email security, and emerging AI security controls. The IAM Lead bridges strategic design with day-to-day operational delivery, ensuring the security controls are robust, audit-ready, and aligned with regulatory obligations.


Key Responsibilities

Identity & Access Management

  • Own end-to-end IAM governance including user lifecycle management, joiner-mover-leaver processes, access provisioning, and entitlement reviews.
  • Design and operate enterprise single sign-on (SSO), federated identity, and conditional access policies across SaaS and on-premises applications.
  • Enforce role-based access control (RBAC) frameworks and least-privilege principles across the organisation.
  • Manage access exception handling, periodic access certifications, and segregation of duties (SoD) controls.

Privileged Access Governance

  • Administer and mature the Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform – covering credential vaulting, session recording, and just-in-time (JIT) access provisioning for administrative accounts.
  • Define and enforce policies for privileged account discovery, onboarding, rotation, and auditing.
  • Ensure privileged session monitoring and forensic capability for high-risk administrative activities.

Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)

  • Operate and tune cloud security posture management tooling to continuously assess misconfigurations, policy drift, and compliance gaps across cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with cloud and infrastructure teams to remediate findings and harden cloud-native workloads.
  • Maintain cloud security benchmarks aligned with CIS, NIST, and regulatory frameworks.

Secure Web Gateway (SWG) & Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)

  • Manage inline traffic inspection policies for web and SaaS application access, enforcing acceptable-use and data protection controls.
  • Drive shadow IT discovery and risk assessment, with structured processes for SaaS application approval and onboarding.
  • Enforce data loss prevention (DLP) policies across SaaS, web browsing, and endpoints – reducing data exfiltration risk without impeding business productivity.

Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR)

  • Operate EDR platforms for behavioural threat detection across user endpoints and servers – tuning detection rules, investigating alerts, and driving real-time remediation.
  • Own incident triage and fix workflows for endpoint security events, including root-cause analysis and configuration hardening.
  • Maintain endpoint health baselines and proactively identify and close vulnerability gaps across the device fleet.

Data Loss Prevention (DLP)

  • Design and maintain DLP policies spanning endpoints, cloud storage, email, and collaboration tools.
  • Classify sensitive data assets in line with enterprise data classification frameworks and apply appropriate protection controls.
  • Investigate DLP incidents, prepare evidence documentation, and drive remediation with data owners.

Mobile Device Management (MDM) & Endpoint Compliance

  • Administer MDM platforms to enforce device enrolment, configuration baselines, and compliance policies for corporate and BYOD devices.
  • Implement and maintain conditional access policies that gate application access based on device health and compliance posture.
  • Manage endpoint lifecycle – provisioning, decommissioning, and remote wipe – in alignment with HR and IT processes.

Email Security

  • Operate and optimise email security controls including anti-phishing, sandboxing, spoofing prevention (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and attachment analysis.
  • Design and execute phishing simulation programmes to measure and improve user security awareness.
  • Investigate email-borne threats and coordinate incident response with the security operations team.

AI Security

  • Govern approved AI tool access across the organisation – managing onboarding, usage policies, and data exposure controls for GenAI applications.
  • Assess and mitigate risks arising from employee use of consumer AI tools, including data leakage and prompt injection exposure.
  • Define and evolve the AI security framework as the organisation’s AI adoption matures.

Compliance, Audit & Governance

  • Prepare and maintain audit-ready evidence, SOPs, and policy documentation for RBI, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, and DPDP Act requirements.
  • Support internal and external audit engagements across all IAM and security tooling domains.
  • Maintain platform health metrics, security dashboards, and executive reporting for all in-scope tools.

Required Skills & Expertise

Deep technical expertise across the following domains is required:

  • Enterprise IAM – user lifecycle, SSO (SAML, OIDC, OAuth), conditional access, RBAC, and directory services (Entra ID / Active Directory).
  • Privileged Access Management – credential vaulting, session recording, JIT provisioning, and PAM platform administration (e.g. CyberArk, BeyondTrust, or equivalent).
  • Cloud Security Posture Management – continuous compliance monitoring, misconfiguration detection, and remediation across multi-cloud environments.
  • Secure Web Gateway & CASB – inline traffic inspection, URL/app filtering, shadow IT visibility, and DLP enforcement for SaaS, web, and endpoints.
  • Endpoint Detection & Response – behavioural threat detection, alert triage, root-cause analysis, and real-time remediation on user endpoints and servers.
  • Data Loss Prevention – policy design and enforcement across endpoints, cloud, and email channels, underpinned by enterprise data classification frameworks.
  • Mobile Device Management – MDM platform administration, device compliance enforcement, and conditional access integration.
  • Email Security – anti-phishing controls, sandboxing, spoofing prevention (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and phishing simulation programme management.
  • AI Security – GenAI application governance, AI usage policy enforcement, and data exposure risk management.
  • Tooling proficiency across Microsoft security suite (Entra ID, Defender, Purview, Intune), and complementary platforms for DLP, EDR, CASB, CrowdStrike, SWG, IAM, PAM, and Email Security.

Education

  • Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology (Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field).
  • Certificate, Degree, or Diploma in Cybersecurity (advantageous but not mandatory).

Preferred Certifications

Not mandatory, but advantageous:

  • CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional

  • Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
  • Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)
  • Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM) or equivalent IAM-specialist certification

jobDescription:
About us

We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You'll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There's no one like you and that's why there's nowhere like RSM.


Position Summary

The Solutions Architecture Manager is a highly proficient, hands-on solution architect for RSM custom solutions. This role owns end-to-end microservice and API architecture for assigned solutions, defines Domain-Driven Design boundaries and event-driven patterns on Azure Service Bus, and sets engineering standards across React frontend and .NET/Python backend teams. The role operates with growing autonomy across the custom solutions estate and represents designs in architecture reviews.


Key Responsibilities

  • Translate business and product requirements into end-to-end solution designs for RSM custom solutions spanning multiple frontend and backend services.
  • Adapt quickly to evolving engineering priorities, market trends, and emerging technologies; rapidly evaluate new technology areas and produce proof-of-concepts, technical assessments, and analysis reports to support timely decision-making and delivery expectations.
  • Design microservice and API architectures for custom-built solutions; define service boundaries using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles.
  • Architect event-driven integration patterns using Azure Service Bus; define message schemas, topic/subscription models, and error-handling strategies.
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices across frontend (React) and backend (.NET / Python) teams.
  • Ensure non-functional requirements (security, scalability, resiliency, observability) are embedded into all solution designs.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews for new features, technical initiatives, and third-party integrations within assigned solutions.
  • Produce and maintain architecture decision records (ADRs), high-level design (HLD) documents, and API specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Collaborating with product managers, UX designers, and engineering leads to shape technical roadmaps.
  • Provide technical mentorship to senior engineers and conduct design and code reviews.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of software engineering or architecture experience, with at least 5 years in a solution architect role on complex, multi-service platforms.
  • Expert-level proficiency in designing microservices architectures and RESTful / GraphQL APIs.
  • Deep hands-on experience with React (frontend architecture) and .NET and/or Python (backend services).
  • Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL database platforms, including data modeling, partitioning, indexing, performance optimization, and selection of appropriate persistence patterns for distributed, cloud-native applications.
  • Working knowledge of observability and operational excellence, including monitoring strategies, distributed tracing, telemetry standards, and production diagnostics using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Strong experience with Azure cloud services, including Azure Service Bus, Azure API Management, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure DevOps.
  • Advanced understanding of Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, Event Sourcing, and distributed systems patterns.
  • Hands-on knowledge and experience in designing and implementing AI-enabled solutions using AI agent frameworks, Azure AI services such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search, and LLMs/SLMs.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevSecOps practices.
  • Working knowledge of OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 and fine-grained authorization in multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including API-led connectivity, event-driven messaging, asynchronous communication patterns, data synchronization, system interoperability, and integration platform technologies used to connect cloud, SaaS, and custom applications.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; experience presenting designs to senior technology stakeholders.
  • Professional services or B2B SaaS product experience is advantageous.


Core Skills & Technologies

  • Microservices Architecture
  • API Design
  • Azure Service Bus
  • React
  • .NET
  • Python
  • Domain-Driven Design
  • Event-Driven Architecture
  • Azure Cloud
  • CI/CD & DevSecOps
  • NFRs
  • Architecture Review

title: Supply Chain Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Summary
The purpose of this role is practical application of data science in supply chain planning and inventory management to improve underlaying processes and deliver financial value.
To succeed in this role, you must have multidisciplinary skill set - proven experience in project management and SC planning, knowledge of planning systems (SAP APO/IBP, OM Partners or similar), SAP architecture (underlying tables, transactions) and strong technical and analytical skills.
In this creative role you will have unique opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders in the global organization working on various improvement initiatives, development of analytical tools, optimization models or supply chain simulations and you need to feel comfortable in each stage of this process (design, develop and deploy) to thrive and succeed.
You are self-starter with hands-on approach and continues improvement mindset working on your own initiative under moderate supervision. You know how to source and use data together with statistical methods and technology to improve processes. It is important you have theoretical knowledge but more important you understand how to use it in practice to add value.
Your nearest assignments will focus on portfolio segmentation, product life cycle management, development of replenishment strategies and inventory optimization within distribution network. All contributing to development of planning tool supporting decision making process for planning teams.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Supply Chain Management or APICS CPIM certification and 5-7+ years experience in Global Supply Chain and Inventory Management essential (multi-site, multi-region),
  • Degree or certification in Data Science desirable,
  • Formal Project Management and problem-solving training desirable, e.g., Six Sigma, Lean.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to select and work with appropriate analytical tools and software (Excel, Power BI, relevant libraries in R and Python or SQL) and build ETL pipelines
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Codex, to accelerate data analysis, code development, documentation, troubleshooting, and creation of analytical tools while applying appropriate validation and governance
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, data quality, business relevance, bias, and operational feasibility before applying them to supply chain planning, inventory optimization, or decision-support processes
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and visualize findings
  • Demonstrated ability to wrangle, cleanse and model data from various sources (SAP, .csv, .xlsx, .txt, .parquet, .rds, data lake etc.)
  • Proficient in Excel and Power BI (Power Query/M, DAX, relational database model, data visualization); Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification is a plus
  • Knowledge of SQL and R/Python highly desirable
  • Experience working with data warehouse/data lake desirable (Snowflake a plus)
  • Knowledge of Statistics and Machine Learning or strong willingness to quickly develop in this area
Working Conditions
Typically works in an office environment with adequate lighting and ventilation and a normal range of temperature and noise level.
Work assignments are diversified. Examples of past precedent are used to resolve work problems.
Most aspects of work are timebound and fit into a standard reporting cycle based on the monthly financial reporting calendar. There is an ongoing requirement to work to deadlines and to manage competing priorities.
Minimal physical effort is required. Work is mostly sedentary but does require walking, standing, bending, reaching, lifting or carrying objects that typically weigh less than 10 lbs.

  • Experience with Program Management Reviews (PMRs), gate reviews, and estimates.
  • Exceptional customer communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to lead through influence across distributed teams.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills in fast-paced environments.
  • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and ability to drive execution with high standards and collaboration.
  • Ability to travel up to 30%.

  • Experience integrating autonomy or software systems onto defense platforms.
  • Experience in software development, autonomy development, or systems engineering.
  • Experience managing clean-sheet defense or technology development programs.
  • PMP and/or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification.
  • Familiarity with MoD contracting, defense acquisition, or national security programs.
  • Experience balancing aggressive timelines with complex engineering constraints.

descriptionFromApi:
Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer / Architect with strong payments, transaction processing, and AI/agent engineering experience to design and build AI-driven solutions capable of executing end-to-end transactions across multiple markets.

The role will own the technical solution from requirements and architecture through agent development, payment integration, testing, and successful transaction execution.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and build AI agents capable of initiating, processing, and completing end-to-end payment transactions.
  • Understand the payment transaction lifecycle and translate payment requirements into agent workflows, business rules, APIs, and system integrations.
  • Analyze market-specific payment requirements and variations and design configurable, reusable solutions.
  • Define architecture for agent orchestration, transaction state management, tool/API invocation, exception handling, retries, and recovery.
  • Integrate agents with payment platforms, gateways, transaction processing systems, APIs, and enterprise services.
  • Define appropriate boundaries between AI-driven decisioning and deterministic payment/business logic.
  • Develop primarily using Python, LLMs, and appropriate agent frameworks.
  • Implement security, authorization, auditability, observability, and guardrails around agent-driven payment actions.
  • Lead end-to-end testing and demonstrate successful transaction execution for each target market.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, conduct design/code reviews, and mentor engineers.

Required Experience:

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including architecture and technical leadership.
  • Strong hands-on Python development experience.
  • Proven experience designing and building LLM/GenAI applications and AI agents.
  • Strong understanding of payments and transaction processing.
  • Experience with payment APIs, gateways, transaction processing platforms, or payment services.
  • Strong understanding of payment lifecycle concepts such as transaction initiation, authorization, processing, transaction status, exceptions, and completion.
  • Strong experience with REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud platforms.
  • Experience designing enterprise integrations and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.

AI / Agent Experience:

  • Experience building AI agents and agent-based workflows.
  • Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and LLM integration.
  • Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or equivalent.
  • Experience implementing AI guardrails, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Ability to determine where AI should be used versus deterministic rules within payment workflows.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience across multiple payment markets or regional payment ecosystems.
  • Knowledge of payment authorization, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, fraud/risk, disputes, or exception management.
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies.
  • Experience designing configurable architectures supporting market-specific payment variations.

Success Criteria:

The successful candidate will be able to take a payment transaction requirement, design the agent and supporting architecture, build the solution, integrate with the required payment systems, and demonstrate a successfully completed transaction for each designated market.

This is a hands-on architecture and engineering role. The candidate must be comfortable coding, debugging, integrating payment systems, and owning the end-to-end technical solution.

Senior RAG Document AI Engineer

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior RAG / Document AI Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade Python/FastAPI microservices that transform enterprise documents into accurate, cited, and reliable answers.

The role will focus on document processing, intelligent chunking, metadata extraction, hybrid retrieval, reranking, retrieval evaluation, and production operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop document processing services for PDF, PPTX, DOCX and other enterprise document formats.
  • Build pipelines using native text extraction, OCR, and vision-language models.
  • Implement table, figure, chart, and infographic extraction.
  • Design configurable and versioned chunking strategies based on document type and structure.
  • Implement hierarchical, parent-child, and section-aware chunking approaches.
  • Develop LLM-based metadata extraction using structured JSON schemas and confidence scoring.
  • Build production RAG retrieval services using dense and sparse retrieval.
  • Implement BM25, hybrid search, rank fusion, metadata filtering, and cross-encoder reranking.
  • Develop context assembly and citation mechanisms for grounded responses.
  • Build retrieval evaluation frameworks using Recall@K, nDCG, MRR, groundedness, and golden Q&A datasets.
  • Monitor retrieval quality and use evaluation metrics to drive improvements.
  • Design incremental and delta ingestion pipelines and support live corpus re-indexing.
  • Build reliable production services with queue/worker patterns, retries, idempotency, and dead-letter handling.
  • Implement structured logging, monitoring, tracing, and production support.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to improve RAG quality, performance, and reliability.

Required Skills

  • 6–10 years of software engineering experience with strong hands-on Python development.
  • 2+ years of experience building and operating production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) or Document AI systems.
  • Strong experience with Python and FastAPI in production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with hybrid retrieval using dense embeddings and BM25.
  • Experience with vector databases and metadata filtering.
  • Strong understanding of embedding models, retrieval strategies, rank fusion, and reranking.
  • Experience with cross-encoder reranking.
  • Practical experience with retrieval evaluation metrics such as Recall@K, MRR, nDCG, and groundedness.
  • Strong experience with document processing, OCR, PDF/PPTX/DOCX extraction, and document AI pipelines.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, structured output, and metadata extraction.
  • Hands-on AWS experience with services such as S3, ECS/EKS, Lambda, Bedrock, Textract, or OpenSearch.
  • Experience with Docker, pytest, Git, CI/CD, structured logging, and distributed service patterns.
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous processing, APIs, queues, workers, retries, and error handling.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working with multimodal RAG or vision-language models.
  • Experience in Life Sciences, Pharma, Healthcare, or other regulated environments.
  • Knowledge of PII/PHI handling and data security.
  • Experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex, with the ability to evaluate when such frameworks are appropriate.
  • Experience with MCP or agent-based tool interfaces.
  • Experience operating RAG systems at scale with large document collections and high concurrent workloads.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong production engineering mindset.
  • Ability to build RAG systems beyond simple API integrations or POCs.
  • Strong understanding of retrieval quality and how to measure and improve it.
  • Experience handling large-scale document ingestion and re-indexing.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and optimize latency, retrieval accuracy, and system reliability.

Senior Product Manager AIOps & Agentic AI (Telecom)

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India | Function: Product Management | Level: Senior Individual Contributor (IC4 / SPM equivalent)

About the Role

Our company is at the forefront of AI-driven network intelligence, powering the next generation of telecom operations through its NITRO AIOps platform a full-stack, domain-agnostic intelligence and automation framework serving Tier-1 and Tier-2 operators globally.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager – AIOps & Agentic AI based in Chennai to own the product definition, backlog strategy, and go-to-market alignment for our AI/ML and Agentic AI capabilities within the NITRO L8 (AIOps Intelligence Layer) and L9 (Vertical Solutions Layer). This is a high-visibility role sitting at the intersection of network operations intelligence, multi-agent AI orchestration, and operator outcome delivery — working closely with solution architects, R&D, platform engineering, and global field teams.

This role reports to the Director of AIOps Solution Architecture (London/global) and operates as the product authority for the India-aligned product development function.

What You Will Own

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and maintain the product backlog and 2-quarter rolling roadmap for AIOps Intelligence and Vertical Solutions capabilities across RAN, Core, and Transport domains
  • Translate operator pain points (MTTR reduction, NOC automation, root cause analysis, proactive anomaly detection) into structured product requirements — PRDs, PDDs, and user stories — with clear acceptance criteria and operator-outcome metrics
  • Lead product discovery with global field teams and customers to validate feature hypotheses before R&D commitment
  • Drive feature prioritisation using value-vs-effort frameworks anchored to operator outcomes, not internal capability milestones

Agentic AI & AI/ML Product Definition

  • Own the product definition for Agentic AI capabilities: multi-agent orchestration workflows, autonomous remediation pipelines, LLM-assisted root cause analysis, and GenAI interfaces for network operations
  • Define human-in-the-loop validation requirements, guardrails, and trust frameworks for autonomous AI features — particularly in safety-critical network operations contexts
  • Partner with R&D and data science teams to define model evaluation criteria, KPIs, and feedback loops for deployed ML models (anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, traffic forecasting)
  • Maintain awareness of emerging frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, Model Context Protocol) and assess applicability to platform capabilities

PDD / PRD Authoring & Artifact Quality

  • Produce operator-grade Product Definition Documents (PDDs) and Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) as primary artifacts, anchoring each to a one-year product goal and a release outcome map
  • Ensure full backlog traceability from PRD to sprint-level user story; drive zero-gap traceability as a team standard
  • Champion agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, AI-assisted pipelines) as a force multiplier for artifact velocity — with mandatory human validation before any commit

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Act as the primary product interface between India-based R&D engineering and global solution architecture, PLM, and field teams
  • Run structured sprint reviews, backlog refinement sessions, and roadmap alignment meetings with a globally distributed team
  • Communicate product decisions, trade-offs, and release outcomes clearly to senior technical and commercial stakeholders
  • Provide market intelligence inputs on Indian operator dynamics (Jio, Airtel, Vi, BSNL/BBNL) to inform localisation and vertical solution priority

Go-to-Market Support

  • Author customer-facing product briefs, capability comparisons, and battlecard inputs for AIOps and Agentic AI features
  • Support pre-sales and solution architecture teams with product positioning for Indian operator bids and RFP responses
  • Track competitive landscape across AIOps vendors (Dynatrace, Datadog, IBM Instana, NETSCOUT) and synthesise inputs into roadmap decisions

What You Bring

Experience

  • 7–12 years of total experience, with a minimum of 4 years in product management (PO or PM) in a B2B technology or telecom domain
  • Demonstrable ownership of AI/ML-powered products from inception to GA release — not just feature contribution
  • Experience working within a global product organisation with distributed engineering and solution architecture stakeholders
  • Prior exposure to telecom operations environments — NOC, OSS, network analytics, or network management — strongly preferred; prior operator-side experience (Jio, Airtel, Vi, Ericsson, Nokia, ZTE, Amdocs, NetCracker) is a differentiator

  • Working knowledge of ML operations concepts: model training pipelines, inference, evaluation metrics, data labelling, and drift monitoring
  • Ability to read and critique API specifications, data schemas, and system architecture diagrams — not required to code, but required to engage meaningfully with engineering at a design level
  • Familiarity with AIOps platform capabilities: event correlation, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, automated remediation, topology mapping
  • Understanding of 5G/LTE network domains at functional level: RAN (gNB, CU/DU split), Core (AMF, SMF, UPF), Transport; sufficient to define domain-specific vertical solutions without requiring constant domain SME support
  • Awareness of agentic AI frameworks and LLM orchestration patterns (RAG, tool use, multi-agent coordination)

Technical Literacy (Preferred)

  • Hands-on experience with agentic tooling: Claude Code, LangChain/LangGraph, n8n, or equivalent — even in personal/prototype context
  • Exposure to telemetry and observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, gNMI/gRPC streaming telemetry
  • Familiarity with cloud-native deployment patterns: Kubernetes, Helm, containerised microservices
